ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Full Extent of Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of child care fraud across the country, including the recent conviction of a Minnesota non-profit leader. It would examine the factors that contribute to this type of fraud and explore potential solutions to prevent it in the future.
questions: What are the most common types of child care fraud?
How can regulators prevent child care fraud in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a widespread problem and spark meaningful change. By following the money and examining the factors that contribute to child care fraud, we can gain a deeper understanding of this issue and identify potential solutions.
